clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge’s Mystic Ward, the Hall of Mysteries brings faith and arcane study together. Dwarven and gnomish practitioners read ancient texts, learn the Holy Light, and weave enchantments within its blue-lit halls.

Blue and purple light marks the Hall of Mysteries amid Ironforge’s stone, iron, and heavy plate. Five soaring pillars shelter scholars in flowing robes. The hall is headquarters for the dwarven priesthood and the Order of the Silver Hand within Khaz Modan, joining arcane study with devotion to the Holy Light. Young clerics and knights study texts such as the Tome of Divinity here. They receive guidance before traveling onward to Stormwind’s Cathedral of Light.
